meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序分阶段推进多步骤任务,出错可重试或修改后继续。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要让多个互有先后依赖的任务按序自动推进。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent subtasks in phases, with retry and repair on failure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to push groups of ordered tasks automatically.

howto.what: Claude 将依赖任务编排成图,分阶段按依赖顺序执行,每阶段验证后再继续。某个子任务失败,可单独重试、发消息纠正或修改定义,已完成部分不重跑。
howto.when: 当用户要求执行 “mass-ulw”、把任务排成依赖图(DAG),或需要扇出式多任务且部分任务必须等另一些完成时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这几个有依赖的任务排成图跑起来。
say.note: Claude 会先做规划,再定义并启动这张依赖图。

say.text: 帮我单独重试刚才失败的那个任务,别动已完成的部分。
say.note: 只给失败节点发起新尝试。

say.text: 给正在运行的子任务发消息,让它只管分配的工作。
say.note: 通过 send 把跑偏的子任务拉回来。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates dependency-ordered tasks as a graph, running them in phases by dependency order and verifying results after each phase. If a node fails, it can retry that node, send it a steering message, or amend the definition; completed work is reused.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to run these dependent tasks as a graph.
say_en.note: Claude plans first, then defines and starts the graph.

say_en.text: Retry the failed node only; don't touch completed ones.
say_en.note: Gives failed nodes a fresh attempt.

say_en.text: Send a message to the running child to keep it on scope.
say_en.note: Steers an off-track child via send.
